items.effective: In force; Sh18.5bn/yr earmarked to airport debt
items.note: Kenya will borrow Sh81bn of a Sh116bn JKIA package, with a bond secured against FUTURE passenger levy collections. No rate rise has been announced — but a levy pledged to bondholders is structurally very hard to cut. Do not model Kenyan air-tax relief into 2027–28 rate cards; write the cost into net-rate contracts instead.

Uganda's Ministry of Health declared the 2026 Bundibugyo outbreak ended on 28 July 2026: 20 confirmed cases, 18 recoveries, 2 deaths, all confined to Kampala and Wakiso, 15 imported from DRC and 5 secondary. Declaration rests on a 'fully documented importation event' — source identified, all transmission chains reconstructed, all 836 contacts closed — counting 42 days from the 16 June discharge of the last Ugandan national, rather than the 16 July date WHO AFRO used when it announced the countdown. NO ENTRY REQUIREMENT HAS CHANGED AS A RESULT: US restrictions run to at least 12 August and DRC transmission continues. Quote the declaration, not a lifting of rules.
items.source: Uganda Ministry of Health / Uganda Media Centre, 28 Jul 2026

items.rule: US Ebola entry restrictions & airport screening
items.amount: No fee — screening and entry limits
items.who: Anyone who has been in DRC, Uganda or South Sudan in the previous 21 days, regardless of nationality — INCLUDING US lawful permanent residents
items.effective: Order signed 13 July 2026, in force to 4:59pm EDT Wednesday 12 August 2026
items.note: CDC order under PHS Act ss.362/365, published at 91 FR 43636 on 16 July 2026, docket CDC-2026-0892. THE GREEN CARD EXEMPTION IS GONE: 42 CFR 71.40(f) was amended on 27 May 2026 (91 FR 31362) and the order applies expressly to lawful permanent residents. Exempt: US citizens and nationals, US military and government personnel on orders, and case-by-case CBP/CDC exceptions. DHS separately funnels affected flights to Washington Dulles (IAD) under 91 FR 29896, 21 May 2026. The order names Nairobi JKIA, Addis Ababa, Doha, Dubai, Brussels and Istanbul as transit corridors of concern — Kenya itself is NOT restricted. PUBLIC COMMENT CLOSES 31 JULY 2026 at regulations.gov under docket CDC-2026-0892; CDC has already refused, in writing, a request to assess Uganda independently of DRC. Next decision point 12 August. UPDATE 29 JUL: Uganda's Ministry of Health declared the outbreak OVER on 28 July 2026 — thirty days before the diarised ~27 August all-clear — so the 12 August renewal now falls AFTER a formal end-of-outbreak declaration, not before it. As at 08:00 EAT 29 July we can find no WHO statement endorsing the declaration and no change to the CDC order or the US Level 4 advisory. Sell 'outbreak over', not 'restrictions lifted'. UPDATE 5 AUG: WHO DON614 (1 Aug| revised 3 Aug) reports epidemiological week 30 as the outbreak's worst week yet (567 cases| 296 deaths) and confirms it is now the largest Ebola outbreak on record in DRC (3|605 confirmed| 1|587 deaths| 44% CFR). A WHO IHR Emergency Committee meets 18 August — six days after the 12 Aug US renewal point.
90-day multiple entry, free movement between the three. Apply through your FIRST country of entry. Materially cheaper than three separate visas — sell multi-country itineraries on it.
